sn46.9:1.1: Sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti || naññatra Tathāgatassa pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa || katame satta || || Satisambojjhaṅgo || la-pe || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo || || Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti || nāññatra Tathāgatassa pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassā ti || ||
